headline: Technical Consultant
summary: Technical consultant experienced in business systems, data validation, requirements analysis, testing, client training, and production support. I bring an operator’s practicality to complicated implementations and build software when a better tool should exist.

experience.description: Enterprise implementation and client delivery for natural gas processing and gathering systems.
accomplishments: Support long-running full-scale implementations, custom enhancements, and upgrade projects for Quorum TIPS Gathering clients in the natural gas processing and gathering space.
Contribute to requirements gathering, functional design, gap analysis, and requirements traceability matrices to align software behavior with client operational workflows.

Write SQL validation queries in Oracle PL/SQL and Microsoft SQL Server to investigate bad data, incorrect configuration, failed processes, and migration issues more efficiently than frontend-only review.
Lead QA, UAT, and pre-production testing, create test walkthroughs, resolve configuration issues, and help support three successful go-lives plus post-production stabilization.

Create user training materials, train clients and an internal colleague, and step into difficult client situations to rebuild trust through consistent follow-through, clearer communication, and reliable delivery.

experience.description: A project-based summer coding camp for elementary and middle-school students.
accomplishments: Co-founded and operated a summer coding camp in Austin across multiple summers, teaching Scratch to more than 50 K-6 students and generating more than $15,000 in revenue.
Delivered daily project-based instruction, planned progressively harder mini-projects, and adapted lessons in real time for students with different skill levels.
Managed parent communication, day-to-day operations, neighborhood and school-based marketing, and instructor interviewing and onboarding to support camp growth.

experience.description: Consultative retail sales and store operations.
accomplishments: Guided customers through mattress selection and purchasing by identifying needs, explaining product options, and closing sales against store targets.
Completed Mattress Firm’s Consultative Selling Curriculum covering the sales process, operating procedures, service standards, and the omni-channel customer journey.
Maintained visual merchandising and planogram standards across the sales floor.
